name: AI data analyst and model evolution (demo)
description: Synthetic demonstration of an evolving AI data analyst that uses governed data models to diagnose an account pattern, preserves competing hypotheses and decision memory, and turns repeated analytical corrections into proposed model capabilities.
processNode: Weekly review of material B2B account order-pattern changes before a manager decides whether to monitor, request account-owner verification, or escalate.
decisionOrAction: Use governed models to decompose an evidence-linked account signal, preserve competing hypotheses and missing evidence, support an accountable human choice of monitor, verify, or escalate, and connect the later outcome without autonomous customer contact or CRM updates.

metrics.name: Decision trace completeness
metrics.definition: Share of in-scope reviews that link the original signal, permitted source evidence, human interpretation, chosen action, rationale, review date, and later observed outcome.

metrics.name: Repeated investigation effort
metrics.definition: Analyst time spent reconstructing evidence and rationale for an account pattern that has already appeared in comparable reviewed cases.
metrics.target: proposed:reduce after a trusted decision-memory view is adopted

metrics.name: Unsupported explanation rate
metrics.definition: Share of review summaries that state a cause or recommended response without cited evidence or an explicit hypothesis label.
metrics.target: proposed:zero unsupported causal claims in the first slice

ontologyReferences.purpose: Proposed definitions for account signal, evidence, fact, hypothesis, analytical model, interpretation, decision, rationale, action, outcome, correction, and model capability candidate.

sourceReferences.purpose: Synthetic order aggregates and comparison periods with source, freshness, and metric-definition version.
Synthetic service, renewal, campaign, and account notes that may support or contradict an interpretation.
Proposed record of human decisions, structured reasons, follow-up observations, corrections, and capability-change candidates.

acceptanceCriteria: Each review identifies its result, semantic-definition version, source evidence, freshness, and access decision, with missing components exposed rather than inferred.
The workflow preserves separate fields for observed facts, deterministic calculations, human interpretations, hypotheses, chosen actions, and later outcomes.
The assistant abstains when permitted evidence is insufficient and cannot label churn, contact a customer, assign work, change account state, or write to CRM autonomously.

A capability candidate is promoted only after repeated evidence, a specifiable contract, replay or shadow comparison, accountable owner acceptance, tests, versioning, observability, release, and rollback are defined.
notes: This record is proposed and synthetic. Real owners, process acceptance, baselines, source authority, semantic definitions, access decisions, thresholds, integrations, and outcome evidence are missing.
